generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Conditional bids, incomplete bids, bids without EMD, bids not uploaded properly and late submission of bids shall be rejected.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Work experience: The prospective Bidder shall have satisfactorily completed, as a prime contractor at least one similar work of Operation & Maintenance of power stations of capacity not less than 10 MW or works carried out in heavy industries / power plant with 110 KV and above outdoor switch yard of value not less than Rs. 3.20 lakhs In any reputed Industry/PSU/Government organization in the preceding five years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof of this, the bidder should submit work done certificate and corresponding work order issued by competent authority(in case of state/central Government/Government under taking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre and in case of KPCL not below the rank of Chief Engineer) shall be furnished (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous work orders to bring the price level to current financial year).
The bidder shall have Class-II and above Electrical Contractor License issued by the Govt. of Karnataka and a copy of the same shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Class-II and above Electrical Contractor License

technicalCriterionList.description: Qualification: The bidder in his name, shall have in the last five years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 6.41 lakhs In proof of this Turnover Certificate duly certified by Charted Accountant shall be furnished. (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous annual turnover value to bring the current price level to current financial year).
